# XWork Technologies LLC

> XWork Technologies LLC builds AI workspace software, secure connectivity, and open infrastructure for hosted and self-managed use.

Website: https://xworktech.com
Support: support@xworktech.com

## Products

- [XWorkmate](https://xworktech.com/products/xworkmate.en.md): Connect models, agents, tools, and data so AI can execute work and deliver durable results.
  - [Official page](https://xworktech.com/products/xworkmate) · [中文](https://xworktech.com/products/xworkmate.md)
- [XConnect](https://xworktech.com/products/xconnect.en.md): XConnect is an open-source AI connectivity accelerator for users worldwide, supporting iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux with real-time diagnostics and repair guidance.
  - [Official page](https://xworktech.com/products/xconnect) · [中文](https://xworktech.com/products/xconnect.md)
- [AI Workspace](https://xworktech.com/products/ai-workspace.en.md): Start conversations, tasks, tool calls, and delivery in the browser with no installation.
  - [Official page](https://xworktech.com/products/ai-workspace) · [中文](https://xworktech.com/products/ai-workspace.md)
- [Open Platform](https://xworktech.com/products/open-platform.en.md): An open platform for self-hosting and developers, keeping control of code, data, and deployment.
  - [Official page](https://xworktech.com/products/open-platform) · [中文](https://xworktech.com/products/open-platform.md)
- [Cloud Hub](https://xworktech.com/products/cloud-hub.en.md): Explore multi-cloud resources and global connectivity architecture for infrastructure selection and self-managed deployment.
  - [Official page](https://xworktech.com/products/cloud-hub) · [中文](https://xworktech.com/products/cloud-hub.md)

## Availability and pricing

Public product information, documentation, and source code are accessible without signing in. Client platforms, versions, and installers are determined by the download center and repository release assets. Source code or a product description does not establish app-store approval.

Start with free access rather than a separate trial plan. See the public pricing page for subscription, pay-as-you-go, and custom terms, quotas, and prices. Free access does not imply that upstream models or self-managed infrastructure have no cost.
